values: 一名擅长对敌人进行狂轰滥炸的坦克，能够配合友军发起远程攻击。
A Tank who specializes in heavy bombardment, supporting allies with powerful long-range fire.
你，来这里。灵活度测试。完毕。
You, step forward. Agility assessment... Good.
好东西，我会把它溶入军械。
How generous. I'll use it for armament.
Great. I'll melt this down for ammunition.
以炮火践踏大地，所行之处，只余焦土。
He pounds the earth with cannon fire, leaving nothing but destruction behind.
Flimsy building. One blast and it's rubble!
勒图姆是位战争专家，在军械的设计与制造上颇有造诣。他身上的盔甲与枪炮，全是由他一手设计打造。
Gunnar is a true veteran and a specialist in armscraft. Every piece of armor and barrel he carries is his personal work.
每一次开口，勒图姆的口中及身体各处的气孔都会向外喷射火焰与蒸汽，他的体温因此经常过高，不得不四处寻找有效的冷却方法。
When Gunnar speaks, steam and flame escape from the vents across his body with a loud hiss, leaving him chronically overheated and always hunting for better cooling solutions.
许多恶魔都认为勒图姆不好相处，但事实证明，他们只是没有找对话题。他对阴谋和恶作剧不屑一顾，但如果与他谈谈军械，他还是很愿意多说几句的。

Hypogeans complain that Gunnar is impossible to get along with. The truth is a simple change of topics sometimes does wonders. Forget plots and pranks. A question about weapons can earn you an unexpectedly long conversation.
勒图姆并不擅长开口说话。曾有位恶趣味的恶魔抓住这点，乐此不疲地要他讲解军械知识。上当数次后，勒图姆选择直接用火炮开口，将其直接轰飞。

Gunnar isn't much of a speaker. Once, a spiteful Hypogean made a game of it—cornering him again and again about weaponry. After the third or maybe the fifth time, Gunnar answered with a cannon blast and ended the talk for good.
“让勒图姆高兴并不难，只需要真诚地夸奖他的盔甲与枪炮。但记住，就算他主动邀请，也不要上手去摸——除非你想被烫伤。”——某位不知名的恶魔。
"If you want Gunnar to like you, compliment his craftsmanship. But keep your hands to yourself. Even if he tells you to touch it. That's how you get scorched." —An anonymous Hypogean
勒图姆最欣赏的恶魔是库露露，尤其是她那火力强劲的炸弹。他期待有一天能和库露露见面，问问她能不能把炸弹装载在自己的枪炮上。
Of all Hypogeans, Gunnar respects Kulu the most, especially her brutal bombs. He's been hoping to meet her one day just to ask if she'd let him mount her explosives onto his own cannons.
勒图姆为自己打造了数量众多的盔甲，时不时就会更换一套。遗憾的是，从没有恶魔发现过这一点，都以为勒图姆从来只穿一套衣服。
Gunnar changes armor often; he's built a whole wardrobe of it. Yet not a single Hypogean has ever noticed, thinking he wears the same outfit every day.
勒图姆身负两门枪炮，但他仍然认为火力尚有进步空间。
Gunnar carries two cannons, and he remains unsatisfied with his firepower.
勒图姆曾尝试在双手和胸口各搭载枪炮，但一次实战让他不得不打消了这个念头：由于温度过高，他的军械直接在战斗过程中融化报废了。
At one point, Gunnar tried to weaponize both his arms and chest. But it only lasted one engagement: overheating turned his arsenal into molten metal.
勒图姆对毁灭世界并不感兴趣，他只是想试验一下军火的强度。至于过程中是否会带来灾难，这就不在他的考虑范畴内了。
Destruction holds no appeal for Gunnar. He simply wants to test how strong his weapons really are. Any incidental disaster is an irrelevant side effect.
哈！搞爆炸的家伙，看你这身架势，怎么，是想造点大动静？
Ha! So you're the boom boom guy. Why? Trying to make a statement?
The place is driving me crazy!
库露露 & 阿爆 & 勒图姆

values.text: The fragile building was shattered by a single shot!
